cues.en: Traffic calming in The Netherlands is a huge topic. Whole books have been written about it, like this one.
cues.zh: 荷兰的交通稳静化是个很大的话题。关于它的整本书都有，比如这一本。

cues.en: But to me, Dutch traffic calming isn't just about the techniques that are used.
cues.zh: 但对我来说，荷兰的交通稳静化不只是用了哪些技术手段。

cues.en: That's interesting, but it's almost secondary.
cues.zh: 那确实有意思，但几乎是次要的。

cues.en: What's really remarkable about The Netherlands is that traffic calming is everywhere.
cues.zh: 荷兰真正了不起的地方在于，交通稳静化无处不在。

cues.en: Where I've lived in Canada and in The US,
cues.zh: 在我住过的加拿大和美国，

cues.en: traffic calming is only applied if there's enough demand for it. If enough people have died at a specific location or enough people complain about it long enough, then traffic calming might be considered.
cues.zh: 只有需求足够大时才会实施交通稳静化。只有在某个地点死的人够多，或者抱怨的人够多、持续够久，才会考虑交通稳静化。

cues.en: For example, Toronto has this convoluted warrant system through which you need to prove that traffic calming is truly required and won't put too much of a burden on those poor drivers.
cues.zh: 多伦多有一套繁琐的交通稳静化审批制度，你得证明确实需要做交通稳静化，而且不会给那些可怜的司机带来太大负担。

cues.en: Even after all this process, traffic calming in Canada is extremely minimal. Yes.
cues.zh: 即便走完所有这些流程，加拿大的交通稳静化仍然少得可怜。是的。

cues.en: This street is traffic calmed. Somebody went through that whole Warren's nonsense to get this.
cues.zh: 这条街做了交通稳静化。有人走完了 Warren 那整套荒唐流程才换来这个。

cues.en: Last summer, I was visiting the neighborhood where I grew up and saw this.
cues.zh: 去年夏天，我回到自己长大的社区，看到了这个。

cues.en: The first sign says traffic calm neighborhood.
cues.zh: 第一块标牌写着“交通稳静化社区”。

cues.en: The second sign says 50 kilometer per hour speed limit. Like, seriously?
cues.zh: 第二块标牌写着限速 50 公里/小时。认真的吗？

cues.en: This two way residential road is 10 meters wide and the quote traffic calming is nothing but a few speed bumps.
cues.zh: 这条双向居住区道路宽 10 米，而所谓的“交通稳静化”不过是几个减速带。

cues.en: There's no one way streets,
cues.zh: 没有单行道，

cues.en: raised crossings,
cues.zh: 抬高式人行横道，

cues.en: continuous sidewalks,
cues.zh: 连续人行道，

cues.en: rough road surfaces,
cues.zh: 粗糙路面，

cues.en: narrowed lanes,
cues.zh: 收窄车道，

cues.en: chicanes,
cues.zh: 蛇形弯道，

cues.en: street cuts,
cues.zh: 街道截断，

cues.en: or anything else.
cues.zh: 或者其他任何措施。

cues.en: This tells you all you need to know about traffic calming in Canada.
cues.zh: 这足以说明加拿大的交通稳静化是什么水平了。

cues.en: Compare that to The Netherlands, where traffic calming is baked into the national road safety guidelines.
cues.zh: 相比之下，在荷兰，交通稳静化已经写入了国家道路安全指南。

cues.en: It doesn't matter if you're in a major city
cues.zh: 不管你是在大城市

cues.en: or in a village.
cues.zh: 还是在村庄。

cues.en: If you're near the city centre
cues.zh: 不管你是靠近市中心

cues.en: or in a suburb,
cues.zh: 还是在郊区，

cues.en: all streets are required to follow the same national guidelines.
cues.zh: 所有街道都必须遵循同一套国家指南。

cues.en: It's still possible to find streets that are not traffic calmed,
cues.zh: 当然，仍然能找到没有做交通稳静化的街道，

cues.en: but that will usually only happen if the street hasn't had a redesign in the past few decades.
cues.zh: 但这通常只发生在那些过去几十年都没重新设计过的街道上。

cues.en: When major construction work is done, a street will be brought up to the latest design standards, traffic calming included.
cues.zh: 大型施工完成后，街道会按最新设计标准改造，包括交通稳静化措施。

cues.en: Consider this crossing.
cues.zh: 看看这个路口。

cues.en: Here, an arterial road meets a crossing with two minor residential streets.
cues.zh: 这里，一条主干道与两条次要的住宅街道相交。

cues.en: The two streets are cut so that cars cannot go from one to the other, but cycling between the two is still permitted.
cues.zh: 两条街之间被隔断，汽车无法互通，但仍允许自行车通行。

cues.en: On the road, the lanes are narrowed by the introduction of a median and visual cues showing that there is a crossing.
cues.zh: 道路上通过增设中央隔离带和表明此处有路口的视觉提示，收窄了车道。

cues.en: And, of course, there's a continuous sidewalk and cycle path on both sides of the street.
cues.zh: 当然，街道两侧都有连续的人行道和自行车道。

cues.en: This street is in Airmilo,
cues.zh: 这条街位于Airmilo，

cues.en: a village of 27,000
cues.zh: 一个拥有2.7万

cues.en: people. And this single crossing in Airmilo probably has more traffic calming than just about any street in Canada and likely The US too.
cues.zh: 人的村庄。而Airmilo的这一处路口，可能比加拿大几乎任何街道——很可能也包括美国——都做了更多交通稳静化措施。

cues.en: These big differences in street design come from the drastically different approaches taken by these countries.
cues.zh: 街道设计上的这些巨大差异，源于这些国家采取了截然不同的做法。

cues.en: In The US and in Canada, streets and roads are judged on level of service.
cues.zh: 在美国和加拿大，街道和道路是按服务水平来评判的。

cues.en: Each street is assessed primarily by its capacity to carry cars.
cues.zh: 每条街道主要按其承载汽车的能力来评估。

cues.en: In The US, a grade is applied from A through F depending on how smoothly traffic flows in the street.
cues.zh: 在美国，会根据街道交通的顺畅程度给出从 A 到 F 的评级。

cues.en: Traffic calming can work against this goal so it will only be permitted if it does not significantly affect level of service.
cues.zh: 交通稳静化措施可能与这一目标相悖，因此只有在不明显影响服务水平时才会被允许。

cues.en: This is why streets in The US and Canada look like highways
cues.zh: 这就是为什么美国和加拿大的街道看起来像高速公路

cues.en: even in city centers.
cues.zh: 即使是在市中心。

cues.en: In The Netherlands,
cues.zh: 在荷兰，

cues.en: a very different approach is taken.
cues.zh: 则采用了截然不同的做法。

cues.en: In the nineteen nineties, a policy called sustainable safety was introduced, which is interesting and deserves its own video at some point.
cues.zh: 20世纪90年代，一项名为“可持续安全”的政策被引入，这很有意思，以后值得单独做一期视频。

cues.en: One of the assumptions of sustainable safety is that humans will make mistakes, so the road itself is designed to protect people and be consistent to make it easier to do the right thing. A local access road is designed so that most people will naturally drive the speed limit, slow down at crossings, and be aware of other road users without being explicitly told to do so.
cues.zh: 可持续安全的一个假设是：人会犯错，因此道路本身要设计得能保护人，并保持一致，让人更容易做出正确行为。地方接入道路的设计目标是，让大多数人无需被明确告知，也会自然按限速行驶、在路口减速，并留意其他道路使用者。

cues.en: This consistent road safety approach makes a huge difference when traveling around The Netherlands.
cues.zh: 这种一致的交通安全做法，让在荷兰各地出行变得大不一样。

cues.en: Unlike in Canada, I know that just about wherever I go in the country, I will never have a problem crossing the street.
cues.zh: 和加拿大不同，我知道在这个国家几乎不管走到哪儿，过马路都不会有问题。

cues.en: I will never feel worried being outside of a car.
cues.zh: 在车外时，我从不会感到担心。

cues.en: And I will never be anxious to walk somewhere.
cues.zh: 我也从不会为步行去某个地方而焦虑。

cues.en: And I'm a lot less concerned about my kids being out in the street as well.
cues.zh: 而且我对孩子们在街上活动也放心得多。

cues.en: Traffic calming can get very technical, so it's easy to get bogged down in the details.
cues.zh: 交通稳静化可能非常技术化，所以很容易陷进细节里。

cues.en: But a consistent safety first approach to road design can make a measurable difference to how it feels to walk or to cycle around the city.
cues.zh: 但道路设计始终把安全放在首位，确实能明显改变在城市里步行或骑行的感受。

cues.en: And for our family, that ultimately means a better quality of life here in The Netherlands.
cues.zh: 对我们家来说，这最终意味着在荷兰能有更好的生活质量。
